name: Google Ads Reports
summary: Exported Google Ads performance and conversion-configuration data used to evaluate spend, traffic, reported outcomes, and measurement readiness.
whatItContains: Campaign names and types, impressions, clicks, cost, reported conversions, conversion value, goals, search queries, and conversion-action settings such as Primary or Secondary, tracking status, and account-default goal inclusion.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Calculate CTR, CPC, reported conversion rate, CPA, and period changes
Identify measurement warnings before campaign optimization
Compare spend concentration and reported-outcome concentration
Review search-term intent with cautious evidence labels
accessMethod: Manual CSV export from Google Ads statistics tables, plus one screenshot from Goals > Conversions > Summary. For recurring workflows, use the Google Ads API with authorized account access.
